Soulmask 1.0 Beginner Guide (Shifting Sands) - MUST KNOW TIPS For NEW PLAYERS
In this video, I'm going to give you some helpful tips to get you off to the best possible start in Soulmask. If you didn't know the game actually went into 1.0 launch today, so the game is fully oout now, out of early access. So if you had the game in early access and you're wondering what they added, now is a good time to jump in. The Shifting Sands DLC is also now live and I will be showcasing a lot of footage from the Shifting Sands, and some of the recommendation that I'm going to have are specifically towards the Shifting Sands DLC.

Get the Game HERE:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460?utm_source=2034
